standard_prerequisites.name: The reduction of universal injectivity to a cover of the target by an algebraic space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 3185-3187) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers universal injectivity from the base change to the morphism itself.

standard_prerequisites.name: The openness on topological spaces of surjective flat morphisms of finite presentation, and the formation of the topological space of an algebraic stack as a quotient of the space of a smooth cover
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 3190-3211)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the homeomorphism on the cover into openness of the induced map on the topological spaces of the test stacks.

core_obligations: Universal injectivity: since the base change is a universal homeomorphism it is universally injective, and the corresponding statement for universally injective morphisms gives the same property for the morphism itself (proof lines 3184-3187)

Set up the test: for a morphism from an algebraic stack the proof chooses a scheme smoothly surjecting onto the fibre product with the given cover and writes down the commutative diagram comparing the covers (proof lines 3188-3202)

Openness: the middle vertical arrow induces a homeomorphism by assumption, and the two horizontal arrows are surjective flat of finite presentation, hence open on topological spaces, which forces the induced map on the topological spaces of the test stacks to be open (proof lines 3203-3211)
Surjectivity: the author records that surjectivity is easy and that its proof is omitted (proof line 3212)
proof_roadmap: 基变换是万有同胚 ⇒ 它万有单射，由本章引理（万有单射可沿覆盖检验）得 f 万有单射。
再取概型 U 满光滑映到 W ×_Y Z，作比较图；中间竖直箭头由假设诱导同胚，两条水平箭头满、平坦、局部有限表现故在拓扑空间上开 ⇒ |Z ×_Y X| → |Z| 开；作者注明满射性易证、证明从略。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks is a universal homeomorphism as soon as its base change along a surjective flat cover of finite presentation of the target by an algebraic space is one (author lemma at source lines 3174-3181, label lemma-check-universal-homeomorphism-covering). The proof (source lines 3183-3213) transfers universal injectivity by the corresponding covering criterion, and proves openness of the induced map on topological spaces by comparing covers in a commutative diagram and using that surjective flat morphisms of finite presentation are open; the author records that surjectivity is easy and its proof is omitted (proof lines 3203-3212). The openness argument through the comparison diagram is the content. H2.
